office: the Ministry of Home Affairs, National Identity and Civil Registration

routes.label: at a National Identity and Civil Registration office

note: The National Identity Cards Act 2011: a citizen of Lesotho (or holder of an indefinite residence permit) of sixteen or over whose particulars are in the Register is eligible for an identity card, issued in the name of the King and valid ten years; replacements are at a prescribed fee. The National Identity and Civil Registry's service delivery charter on the Government's e-services site (read 2026-10-30) lists enrolment for an identity card, and its renewal or replacement, as free, with a timeline of one hour, which is taken as the route's time; the Ministry's FAQ, read 2026-10-29, gives passport fees only.

sources.title: Lesotho, National Identity Cards Act 2011 (Act 9 of 2011), WHO country planning cycle database copy
sources.said: Eligibility for identity card The following persons are eligible to be issued with identity cards provided that they have attained the age of sixteen and their particulars have been entered in the Register— ... An identity card shall be issued in the name of the King and shall be valid for a period of ten years.
